scope: Compact extract of the X-COP data release for CL-2A; every number is a release product, not a raw observation

sources.release: X-COP data release (D. Eckert and collaborators), the archive linked from the data page
sources.density: Ghirardini et al. 2019, A&A 621, A41 (arXiv:1805.00042): electron density by the L1-penalty deprojection
sources.thermodynamics: Ghirardini et al. 2019: X-ray temperature and pressure, SZ pressure (Planck), X/SZ temperature; self-similar scalings T500, P500 in the headers
sources.masses: Ettori et al. 2019, A&A 621, A39 (arXiv:1805.00035): hydrostatic mass profiles for several mass models (forward, NFW, Einasto)
sources.stars: Ghizzardi et al. 2021 (as cited in the release headers): cumulative stellar mass profiles, seven clusters
sources.cosmology: the release's own H0 = 70, Omega_m = 0.3 distances, adopted as scenario inputs (universe contract)

units.radius: kpc unless a column is named r_over_R500
units.P: P500 units, P500 in keV cm^-3
units.molecular_weights_used_by_the_release: mu = 0.6 per particle, mu_e = 1.14 per electron

density.note: electron density in shells, L1-penalty deprojection; lo/hi are the release's bounds

pressure.note: electron pressure scaled by P500; X-ray points from n_e kT, SZ points from Planck

gas_mass.note: RADIUS in units of R500; MGAS the release's gas mass, M_NFW its hydrostatic NFW mass

stellar_mass.note: cumulative stellar mass, smoothed, total uncertainties
